Outlets Discuss Cooking Oils, Peanut Oil Extraction Methods

Two Hindi news outlets, Aaj Tak and News18 Hindi, both right-leaning, have published articles discussing cooking oils. Aaj Tak provides a method for extracting peanut oil at home using a mixer, claiming 1 kg of peanuts yields 400g of pure oil. News18 Hindi features a doctor's advice on the best cooking oils for health, comparing peanut, refined, and mustard oils.
